name: The God Hakkar
summary: Yeh'kinya asks you to bring him Hakkar's filled egg in Tanaris. Its stirring life raises a fear about the god's return.

sections.title: Yeh'kinya's Concern
sections.body: After Hakkar's essence has empowered the egg, Yeh'kinya in Tanaris receives it from you. The egg stirs with life, and he wonders whether the myths of Hakkar are true. He fears what Hakkar might do if born again, so he intends to keep the egg from evil hands.

faq.q: Who is asking for the egg?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya asks you to bring him the Filled Egg of Hakkar in Tanaris.

faq.q: What is the Filled Egg of Hakkar?
faq.answer: The egg holds Hakkar's essence, and it stirs with life.

faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want the egg?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya fears what Hakkar may do if born again, so he plans to keep the egg from evil hands.
Hakkar's essence empowers the egg, which then stirs with life.

attribution: In-game quest text: The God Hakkar
